name: XARVB
description: 22.05 kHz half-rate 16-bit hardware reverb with 5 space presets (Room, Studio, Hall, Space, Pipe) and momentary footswitch.

params.name: Mode
params.explanation: Sony PS1 SPU BIOS reverb algorithm (Room, Studio, Hall, Space Echo, Pipe).

params.name: Decay
params.explanation: SPU vWALL reflection feedback / reverb tail duration (0..100).

params.name: PreD
params.explanation: Pre-delay before the SPU reverb tank (0..90 ms).

params.name: Damp
params.explanation: SPU vIIR 22.05 kHz internal tank high-frequency damping (0 = bright metallic, 100 = dark).

params.name: Early
params.explanation: SPU dAPF1/dAPF2 all-pass diffusion and fluttery early reflections (0..100).

params.name: Mix
params.explanation: Dry/Wet blend (0 = dry, 50 = unity dry + wet, 100 = 100% wet SPU tank).

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Master output level (80 is unity at nominal MS-70CDR+ bus level).

params.name: ON/OFF
params.explanation: LATCH: normal toggle. UNLATCH: momentary while held.
